# <span id="aanchor421"></span> Create Close Groups

A close group consists of a meter or a set of meters that should be closed together on the same date. Once a close group is created and meters have been assigned to it, you can generate automatic monthly close schedules for the group, or you can close it manually, just as with a list.

<div class="procedure">

To create a close group:

1.  Go to **Setup** \> **Close Groups** to access the Close Groups screen.

    The close schedule type within the FLOWCAL Options screen must be set to "Close Group" to enable access to the Close Group screen.

2.  Click **New**

3.  Enter a close group number (required) and a close group name (optional).

4.  Check the "Enable" option to enable the close group.

5.  Click **Save**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 540;height: 401;" />

Administrators must have the "Application Process – Close Groups" privilege, granted from the User or Group Access screen, to create and edit close groups.

 

</div>
